extName.description: Same string as in en on purpose. The manifest has no way to say that a key is not translated, so it is repeated rather than left out; leaving it out would fall back to en anyway, but silently.

extDescription.message: Ripubblica su Vinted con un solo clic: copia foto e dettagli. Nulla viene eliminato finché la copia non è pronta. Torna in cima.
